assembly_instructions: 1. Place four rubber feet on the floor, then bolt the left and right 2020 Y-axis extrusions to the front and rear 2020 cross-bars to make a 0.50 m by 0.44 m rectangular base.

2. Fasten the split rear aluminium sheet frame to the rear cross-bar: install the left upright, right upright, bottom bridge, top bridge, angled sheet legs, rounded cutout markers, and Z motor mounting hole markers so the central window remains open.
3. Install the two 8 mm Y smooth rods on the base rails, add the front Y idler, rear Y motor pulley, and Y belt clamp, then loop the GT2 Y belt along the centreline.
4. Fit the three Y linear bearing blocks to the rods, bolt the Y-carriage plate to them, add the nine heatbed spacers in a 3 by 3 grid, then mount the MK52 heatbed and PEI spring-steel print sheet.
5. Clamp the two 10 mm Z smooth rods and two T8 lead screws into the rear frame, add top Z motors and couplers, and connect each lead screw to the X-axis gantry.
6. Build the X-axis gantry from the paired 8 mm X smooth rods, left and right printed X-end blocks, rear belt support bar, X motor pulley, left idler pulley, X belt runs, and carriage belt clamp.

7. Assemble the direct-drive extruder on the X-carriage: mount the printed body, E motor, idler door, Bondtech gears, PTFE inlet sleeve, filament sensor, heatsink, fan, part-cooling blower and duct, heatbreak, heatblock, heater cartridge, thermistor, brass nozzle, and SuperPINDA probe.

8. Bolt the cutaway Einsy RAMBo electronics case to the right rear frame, leave the ventilated lid offset, install the exposed controller board, three TMC driver blocks, terminal subdivisions, power input, X/Z wiring loom, and heatbed wiring loom.
9. Mount the LCD bracket, glass display, and rotary encoder to the front cross-bar, then connect the LCD ribbon to the electronics case.

10. Fit the top spool holder brackets and axle, place the 1 kg filament spool with hub, flanges, and wound coil bands on the axle, then route 1.75 mm filament through the spool eyelet, guide tube, PTFE inlet, Bondtech gears, and hotend throat.
11. Square the base, tension the X and Y belts, verify all feet sit at y = 0, confirm the nozzle sits just above the sheet, and mesh-level the 250 x 210 mm print surface.

info.english_name: Original Prusa i3 MK3S+ FDM 3D Printer
info.summary: Flagship open-source bed-slinger FDM printer from Prusa Research. 250×210×210 mm build volume, direct-drive Bondtech extruder, magnetic removable spring-steel sheet, filament and power-loss sensors.
info.description: The Original Prusa i3 MK3S+ is the production workhorse of the Prusa i3 family — itself the longest-running open-source derivative of Josef Prusa's original RepRap i3. The printer follows the classic bed-slinger kinematics: the heat bed moves on the Y axis along two parallel M8 smooth rods on a 2020 aluminium base, while a cantilevered single-sheet aluminium frame at the rear carries the XZ gantry. Two Z-motors with T8 lead screws raise and lower the X-axis assembly; the X-carriage rides on paired smooth rods and carries the MK3S+ direct-drive extruder with a Bondtech dual-gear feeder, an E3D V6-compatible hotend, and a 0.4 mm brass nozzle. The removable magnetic spring-steel PEI sheet on top of the heated bed lets prints pop off by flexing. A SuperPINDA probe handles mesh bed levelling; an IR filament sensor and power-panic detection are built into the extruder. Firmware, electronics (Einsy RAMBo with TMC2130 drivers), and full CAD are released on GitHub — the printer is one of the most-cloned FDM designs in existence.
info.operator: Prusa Research customers + the wider open FDM community
info.contractor: Prusa Research (Josef Prusa et al., Prague)
info.contract_date: MK3S released Feb 2019 · MK3S+ upgrade released Oct 2020
info.status: In production through MK4/MK4S successor; MK3S+ still sold / upgradable

facts.label: Heat bed
facts.value: MK52 magnetic base + removable PEI-coated spring-steel sheet

facts.label: Axes
facts.value: X: paired 8 mm smooth rods · Y: 2× M8 smooth rods · Z: 2× lead screws + 2× smooth rods

facts.label: Electronics
facts.value: Einsy RAMBo, TMC2130 stealthChop drivers, IR filament sensor, SuperPINDA

parts.name: Rear 2020 Cross-Bar
parts.role: Rear cross-member ties the Y rails together and anchors the rear sheet frame and Y motor.

parts.name: Right Rear Rubber Foot

parts.role: Left side of the single-sheet aluminium rear frame, modelled separately so the central gantry window is open.

parts.name: Laser-Cut Frame Right Upright
parts.role: Right side of the single-sheet aluminium rear frame, exposing the Z rods and lead screws instead of hiding them.

parts.name: Rear Frame Bottom Bridge
parts.role: Lower sheet bridge bolts the rear frame to the Y base while leaving the build area visible.

parts.name: Rear Frame Top Bridge
parts.role: Top sheet bridge carries the Z motor mounts and the spool holder without closing the central window.

parts.name: Left Angled Frame Leg
parts.role: Angled lower sheet web gives the rear frame the recognizable Prusa A-frame silhouette.

parts.name: Right Angled Frame Leg
parts.role: Mirrored lower sheet web gives the rear frame stiffness without hiding the carriage.

parts.name: Left Rounded Frame Cutout Marker
parts.role: Dark circular marker represents the rounded relief cutout in the laser-cut left frame plate.

parts.name: Right Rounded Frame Cutout Marker
parts.role: Dark circular marker represents the rounded relief cutout in the laser-cut right frame plate.

parts.name: Left Z Motor Mount Hole Marker
parts.role: Round surface marker shows the bolt pattern area for the left Z motor mount in the frame sheet.

parts.name: Right Z Motor Mount Hole Marker
parts.role: Round surface marker shows the bolt pattern area for the right Z motor mount in the frame sheet.

parts.name: Top Bridge Central Cutout Marker
parts.role: Dark slot marker indicates the central lightening cutout in the top of the sheet frame.

parts.name: Bottom Bridge Service Cutout Marker
parts.role: Dark slot marker indicates the lower sheet-frame opening around the Y motor and wiring route.

parts.name: Y-Axis Smooth Rod Left 8 mm
parts.role: Hardened 8 mm linear rod guides the left side of the moving bed carriage along Y.

parts.name: Y-Axis Smooth Rod Right 8 mm
parts.role: Second 8 mm linear rod keeps the Y carriage square and level through the 210 mm bed travel.

parts.name: Y Bearing Left Front
parts.role: Linear bearing block clamps the front-left side of the Y carriage to the left smooth rod.

parts.name: Y Bearing Left Rear
parts.role: Linear bearing block supports the rear-left side of the Y carriage on the left rod.

parts.name: Y Bearing Right Center
parts.role: Single right-side bearing block completes the MK3S+ three-bearing Y carriage support.

parts.name: Y-Carriage Aluminium Plate
parts.role: Thin aluminium Y plate rides on three bearings and carries the heated bed and belt clamp.

parts.name: Y-Carriage Belt Clamp
parts.role: Printed clamp fastens the upper Y belt run to the underside of the moving carriage.

parts.name: MK52 Magnetic Heatbed
parts.role: Heated magnetic PCB provides the 250 x 210 mm print area and mounts above a nine-point spacer grid.

parts.name: PEI Spring-Steel Print Sheet
parts.role: Removable PEI-coated spring-steel sheet is the visible print surface that flexes to release parts.

parts.name: Front Print Sheet Pull Tab
parts.role: Small front lip marks the removable spring-steel sheet and gives the operator a grip point.

parts.name: Rear Print Sheet Alignment Tab
parts.role: Rear tab shows the sheet registration edge against the MK52 magnetic bed.

parts.name: Heatbed Spacer Front Left
parts.role: Metal standoff sets the heatbed height above the Y carriage at the front-left screw.

parts.name: Heatbed Spacer Front Center
parts.role: Center-front standoff supports the MK52 bed near the front edge screw.

parts.name: Heatbed Spacer Front Right
parts.role: Metal standoff sets the heatbed height above the Y carriage at the front-right screw.

parts.name: Heatbed Spacer Middle Left
parts.role: Middle-left standoff keeps the heated PCB flat across the left side.

parts.name: Heatbed Spacer Middle Center
parts.role: Central standoff is the middle screw point of the nine-point MK52 mounting grid.

parts.name: Heatbed Spacer Middle Right
parts.role: Middle-right standoff keeps the heated PCB flat across the electronics side.

parts.name: Heatbed Spacer Rear Left
parts.role: Rear-left standoff keeps the heated bed parallel to the carriage plate.

parts.name: Heatbed Spacer Rear Center
parts.role: Rear-center standoff supports the MK52 bed near the rear cable exit.

parts.name: Heatbed Spacer Rear Right
parts.role: Rear-right standoff keeps the heated bed parallel to the carriage plate.

parts.name: NEMA17 Y Motor
parts.role: Rear NEMA17 stepper drives the Y belt that moves the bed forward and backward.

parts.name: Y Motor GT2 Pulley
parts.role: Small toothed pulley on the Y motor shaft redirects the GT2 belt at the rear.

parts.name: Front Y Idler Pulley
parts.role: Front idler pulley returns the Y belt and visibly closes the bed-slinger belt loop.

parts.name: Y Belt Upper Run
parts.role: Upper GT2 belt run clamps to the Y carriage and transmits motor motion to the bed.

parts.name: Y Belt Lower Return
parts.role: Lower GT2 belt return completes the closed loop below the carriage plate.

parts.name: Z-Axis Smooth Rod Left 10 mm
parts.role: Left 10 mm vertical smooth rod guides the X gantry without carrying drive torque.

parts.name: Z-Axis Smooth Rod Right 10 mm
parts.role: Right 10 mm vertical smooth rod keeps the X gantry parallel to the bed.

parts.name: Z-Axis Lead Screw Left T8
parts.role: Left T8 lead screw raises and lowers the left end of the X-axis gantry.

parts.name: Z-Axis Lead Screw Right T8
parts.role: Right T8 lead screw raises and lowers the right end of the X-axis gantry.

parts.name: Left Z Rod Bottom Clamp
parts.role: Printed lower clamp locates the bottom of the left Z smooth rod on the rear frame.

parts.name: Right Z Rod Bottom Clamp
parts.role: Printed lower clamp locates the bottom of the right Z smooth rod on the rear frame.

parts.name: Left Z Rod Top Clamp
parts.role: Printed top clamp captures the left Z smooth rod near the top bridge.

parts.name: Right Z Rod Top Clamp
parts.role: Printed top clamp captures the right Z smooth rod near the top bridge.

parts.name: Left Z NEMA17 Motor
parts.role: Left Z-axis stepper sits at the top of the frame and turns the left lead screw.

parts.name: Right Z NEMA17 Motor
parts.role: Right Z-axis stepper sits at the top of the frame and turns the right lead screw.

parts.name: Left Z Flexible Coupler
parts.role: Flexible coupler joins the left motor shaft to the T8 lead screw.

parts.name: Right Z Flexible Coupler
parts.role: Flexible coupler joins the right motor shaft to the T8 lead screw.

parts.name: Rear X Belt Support Bar
parts.role: Slim rear support visually carries the belt loop while the paired X smooth rods provide the actual carriage guide geometry.

parts.name: Left X-End Printed Block
parts.role: Left printed X-end ties the X rods to the left Z rod and carries the idler pulley.

parts.name: Right X-End Printed Block
parts.role: Right printed X-end ties the X rods to the right Z rod and supports the X motor.

parts.name: Upper X Smooth Rod 8 mm
parts.role: Upper horizontal rod gives the X carriage a visible precision guide surface across the frame.

parts.name: Lower X Smooth Rod 8 mm
parts.role: Lower horizontal rod keeps the X carriage from rotating under extruder load.

parts.name: Left X-Axis Bearing Block
parts.role: Bearing block grips the upper X rod and transfers left-side guidance into the carriage.

parts.name: Center X-Axis Bearing Block
parts.role: Central bearing support keeps the X carriage aligned on the lower rod.

parts.name: Right X-Axis Bearing Block
parts.role: Bearing block grips the upper X rod and transfers right-side guidance into the carriage.

parts.name: Right X NEMA17 Motor
parts.role: Right-end X stepper drives the belt that moves the extruder across the build plate.

parts.name: X Motor GT2 Pulley
parts.role: Toothed pulley on the X motor shaft pulls the X belt loop.

parts.name: Left X Idler Pulley
parts.role: Left idler pulley returns the X belt at the opposite end of the gantry.

parts.name: X Belt Front Run
parts.role: Front run of the GT2 belt is clamped to the X carriage and moves the extruder laterally.

parts.name: X Belt Rear Return
parts.role: Rear return run completes the closed X belt loop behind the carriage.

parts.name: X-Carriage Printed Plate
parts.role: Printed PETG carriage bolts to the X belt and supports the complete direct-drive extruder.

parts.name: X-Carriage Belt Clamp
parts.role: Small clamp on the carriage locks the front X belt run to the moving extruder assembly.

parts.name: MK3S+ Direct-Drive Extruder Body
parts.role: Printed extruder body houses the open filament path, Bondtech gears, idler door, and hotend clamp.

parts.name: Bondtech Idler Door
parts.role: Hinged printed door exposes the idler gear side of the Bondtech feed mechanism.

parts.name: Extruder NEMA17 Motor
parts.role: Direct-drive E motor sits on the extruder face and turns the Bondtech reduction gears.

parts.name: Bondtech Drive Gear Left
parts.role: Knurled drive gear grips one side of the 1.75 mm filament path.

parts.name: Bondtech Idler Gear Right
parts.role: Counter gear pinches filament against the driven gear for reliable direct extrusion.

parts.name: Extruder Filament Inlet
parts.role: Short vertical guide tube aligns 1.75 mm filament before it reaches the IR sensor and gears.

parts.name: PTFE Inlet Sleeve
parts.role: White PTFE sleeve marks the constrained feed bore between the top inlet and the drive gears.

parts.name: IR Filament Sensor
parts.role: IR optical sensor above the drive path detects filament presence before it reaches the gears.

parts.name: E3D V6 Heatsink
parts.role: Finned metal heatsink keeps the upper hotend cool above the heatbreak.

parts.name: V6 Heatbreak Throat
parts.role: Narrow metal heatbreak connects the cool heatsink to the hot heater block while limiting heat flow.

parts.name: Hotend Cooling Fan
parts.role: Square 40 mm fan blows through the V6 heatsink to prevent heat creep.

parts.name: Part Cooling Blower Fan
parts.role: Radial blower fan cools freshly extruded plastic independently from the hotend heatsink fan.

parts.name: Nozzle Cooling Duct
parts.role: Printed air duct aims blower output at the nozzle tip and newly deposited bead.

parts.name: E3D V6 Heater Block
parts.role: Heater block contains the cartridge heater and thermistor and transfers heat to the nozzle.

parts.name: Heater Cartridge
parts.role: Cylindrical heater cartridge passes through the aluminium block to melt filament.

parts.name: Hotend Thermistor Bead
parts.role: Small temperature sensor bead reads heater-block temperature for closed-loop control.

parts.name: 0.4 mm Brass Nozzle
parts.role: Tapered brass nozzle forms the final molten plastic outlet just above the print sheet.

parts.name: Nozzle Exit Tip
parts.role: Tiny cylindrical outlet marks the 0.4 mm extrusion point directly above the build surface.

parts.name: SuperPINDA Probe
parts.role: Inductive probe sits beside the nozzle and measures the steel sheet for mesh bed levelling.

parts.name: SuperPINDA Sensing Face
parts.role: Flat lower sensing face shows the probe height relative to the brass nozzle and sheet.

parts.name: Einsy RAMBo Electronics Case
parts.role: Controller enclosure bolts to the right rear frame and is shown as a cutaway around the exposed board.

parts.name: Exposed Einsy RAMBo Board
parts.role: Visible controller PCB inside the open case carries the stepper drivers and wiring terminals.

parts.name: X-Axis TMC2130 Driver Block
parts.role: Individual heat-spreader block marks the X-axis Trinamic driver on the exposed controller board.

parts.name: Y-Axis TMC2130 Driver Block
parts.role: Individual heat-spreader block marks the Y-axis Trinamic driver on the exposed controller board.

parts.name: Z/E TMC2130 Driver Block
parts.role: Individual heat-spreader block marks the combined Z and extruder driver area on the exposed board.

parts.name: Einsy Power Terminal Pair
parts.role: Power terminal pair receives supply input and power-panic wiring at the bottom of the board.

parts.name: Einsy Heatbed Terminal Pair
parts.role: Heatbed terminal pair anchors the moving bed heater and thermistor loom.

parts.name: Einsy Hotend Terminal Pair
parts.role: Hotend terminal pair anchors heater, thermistor, fan, and X carriage wiring.

parts.name: Einsy Case Offset Ventilated Lid
parts.role: Removable side lid is offset from the case as an exploded cutaway so the controller interior remains visible.

parts.name: Upper Einsy Lid Vent Slot
parts.role: Bright slit marks the upper ventilation opening in the offset controller lid.

parts.name: Lower Einsy Lid Vent Slot
parts.role: Bright slit marks the lower ventilation opening in the offset controller lid.

parts.name: Rear Power Input Socket
parts.role: Rear connector block indicates where mains and power-panic wiring enter the electronics case.

parts.name: X/Z Motor Wiring Loom
parts.role: Bundled cable run from the electronics case to the X carriage, hotend sensors, and Z motors.

parts.name: Heatbed Wiring Loom
parts.role: Flexible heated-bed cable bundle routes from the moving bed to the controller case.

parts.name: Heatbed Cable Strain Relief
parts.role: Printed strain-relief block fixes the moving heatbed cable where it exits the rear of the bed.

parts.name: Front LCD Bracket
parts.role: Printed front bracket mounts the control display to the front cross-bar, matching the real MK3S+ layout.

parts.name: Monochrome LCD Display
parts.role: Front monochrome LCD presents printer menus and status to the operator.

parts.name: Rotary Click Encoder
parts.role: Round push encoder beside the LCD provides the single-knob user interface.

parts.name: LCD Ribbon Cable
parts.role: Flat cable routes the front LCD controls back toward the electronics case.

parts.name: Left Spool Holder Bracket
parts.role: Left top bracket supports one end of the filament spool axle above the frame.

parts.name: Right Spool Holder Bracket
parts.role: Right top bracket supports the other end of the filament spool axle above the frame.

parts.name: Filament Spool Axle
parts.role: Horizontal axle passes through the spool hub and lets the 1 kg spool rotate freely.

parts.name: Filament Spool Hub
parts.role: Central hub represents the wound filament core around the support axle.

parts.name: Left Spool Flange
parts.role: Outer flange of the 1 kg filament spool keeps the coil from sliding off the left side.

parts.name: Right Spool Flange
parts.role: Outer flange of the 1 kg filament spool keeps the coil from sliding off the right side.

parts.name: Front Wound Filament Coil
parts.role: Front visible loop indicates the filament is wound as layered coil on the spool core.

parts.name: Middle Wound Filament Coil
parts.role: Middle visible loop shows the bulk of the 1 kg filament wound between the flanges.

parts.name: Rear Wound Filament Coil
parts.role: Rear visible loop completes the wound filament pack between the spool flanges.

parts.name: Filament Spool Exit Eyelet
parts.role: Small loop marks the point where free filament leaves the wound spool before entering the guide path.

parts.name: Filament Guide Tube
parts.role: Short guide tube keeps the feed path aimed from the top spool toward the extruder inlet.

parts.name: Filament Segment Spool to Eyelet
parts.role: First free filament segment peels off the coil and reaches the spool exit eyelet.

parts.name: Filament Segment Eyelet to Guide
parts.role: Second filament segment drops from the spool eyelet into the upper guide tube rather than passing as an unsupported straight line.

parts.name: Filament Segment Guide to Inlet
parts.role: Third filament segment leaves the guide tube and enters the extruder filament inlet above the IR sensor.

parts.name: Filament Segment Inlet to Bondtech Gears
parts.role: Short vertical segment shows constrained filament passing through the PTFE sleeve into the Bondtech gears.

parts.name: Filament Segment Gears to Heatbreak
parts.role: Final internal feed segment continues from the Bondtech gears down into the hotend throat.
